# Nexus Launch Waitlist

> Try a coming-soon website demo with original artwork, countdown, sharing, and validated signup. Signup is temporary and sends no launch notifications.

## About this demonstration

This is a fictional launch demonstration. POST /api/waitlist validates email and stores it only in temporary Worker-isolate memory. No mailing list or launch notification is created.
